title: authentik Overview
description: An authentik instance's event log: logins and failed logins, MFA, passwords, impersonation, suspicious requests, applications authorized, administrative changes and errors.

definition.content:
**authentik** is an open-source identity provider: single sign-on (OAuth2/OIDC, SAML, LDAP, proxy), MFA and application access. This dashboard follows the connected instance's event log: who logs in and from where, failed logins and the users, addresses and countries behind them, MFA authenticators enrolled or removed, passwords changed, impersonation, suspicious requests, the applications users are authorized to, administrators' changes to users, groups, applications, providers, flows and policies, and the instance's own errors.

Connect an instance in [Integrations → authentik](/integrations/authentik): ObserveCraft reads its events API every minute, with no access to ObserveCraft needed.
